settings.heading: The Challenge
settings.body: Dummiez is a design-led brand whose products are the whole pitch, but a conventional Shopify theme flattened them into thumbnails. The brand read as generic in the first five seconds, and the storefront did nothing to communicate the craft behind the product.

settings.heading: What We Built
settings.body: We built a custom Shopify Plus storefront around a real-time 3D stage, so the product is the interface rather than a picture of the product. The build pairs a bespoke theme with a WebGL scene that respects reduced-motion preferences and degrades to static imagery where WebGL is unavailable.
